purpose: Define which MCP mailroom response fields are safe for external agent packets and which must remain server-internal diagnostics.

public_fields.name: instruction
public_fields.purpose: Short state-specific instruction for the agent.

public_fields.name: forms
public_fields.purpose: Allowed state actions/forms the agent may submit.

public_fields.name: warnings
public_fields.purpose: Actionable warnings, phrased without internal route details.

public_fields.name: next_safe_action
public_fields.purpose: One concrete next step for the agent.

public_fields.name: receipt
public_fields.purpose: External acknowledgement of a submitted form/action.

internal_fields.name: route_id
internal_fields.purpose: Internal route selected to fulfill a public form/action.

internal_fields.name: internal_tool
internal_fields.purpose: Server-private MCP tool or service used for execution.

internal_fields.name: expected_metadata
internal_fields.purpose: Expected postcondition metadata for route health comparison.

internal_fields.name: actual_metadata
internal_fields.purpose: Actual result metadata returned by the internal route/tool.

internal_fields.name: route_health_event
internal_fields.purpose: Health/audit event generated by metadata mismatch or route failure.

internal_fields.name: raw_tool_payload
internal_fields.purpose: Unfiltered internal payload used for debugging and audit.
